      "evidence": "Minor adaptations in src/policy/packages.cpp to take transaction IDs rather than full references are follow-ups to TxOrphanage's internal serialization changes rather than policy changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter mempool acceptance, eviction, or policy rules."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies orphan handling and memory accounting across src/node/txorphanage.cpp and transaction download management.",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.85,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Fixes a memory exhaustion DoS vector where peers bypass orphanage memory accounting using standard-weight transactions with many small witness elements. Specifically, a transaction of 199,000 1-byte witness elements consumes ~11.1MB of heap memory—28 times its accounted weight limit—allowing peers to exhaust node memory or trigger multi-hundred megabyte spikes."
    },

      "name": "tests",
